LESSON: HANDWRITING

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.2: Handwriting

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Handwriting
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do you sit when Learners practise handwriting every week strand, the learner should patterns. writing?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. practise Handwriting
2. use Handwriting in clear sentences

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Handwriting

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Handwriting

Teach
• Focus skill: Handwriting.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Handwriting.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Handwriting
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do you sit when Learners practise handwriting every week strand, the learner should patterns. writing?
2. what they learnt. Are they able to help others write better?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
